items.title: Built a physical simulation of a record player with WebGL2 and Web Audio
items.text: Built a physical simulation of a record player with WebGL2 and Web Audio. It's *shockingly* accurate: https://t.co/MBNaTfKoai. Instead of playing a song, it works by converting it into the physical shape of a groove. Then a simulated stylus rides those walls 384,000 times a second, and you hear the voltage that motion would induce in a cartridge. So the crackle, the pops, the wow/flutter, the dull inner grooves are natural byproducts of the simulation. You can also "DJ" the record. (The converted songs are in the public domain or CC-licensed. Code is linked for you to remix and re-deploy.)
